premises: A pre-oxidation treatment can form a continuous Cr-rich (Cr2O3) oxide layer on FeNiCrCoCu coatings.
A continuous Cr2O3 layer acts as a protective barrier that reduces direct metallic contact during sliding.
Reducing direct metallic contact limits adhesive bonding, plastic deformation, and oxidative wear.
The protective effect of the Cr2O3 layer is stable and effective under high-temperature (700–900 °C) and high-load conditions.
